description: Validates Kubernetes probe configurations for handler completeness, threshold correctness, port alignment, and safe timing relationships between liveness, readiness, and startup probes

rules.description: probe-config-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare containerPorts (non-empty array) and probes
Both liveness and readiness probes must be defined. liveness detects stuck containers; readiness controls traffic routing during startup and degradation

Every probe must have exactly one handler: httpGet (with path + port), tcpSocket (with port), exec (with non-empty command array), or grpc (with port). The kubelet rejects probes with missing handler fields

All timing fields (initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, timeoutSeconds, successThreshold, failureThreshold) must be positive integers. liveness.successThreshold must be exactly 1 — the Kubernetes API server rejects any other value

liveness.successThreshold.reason: Kubernetes API server rejects liveness probes with successThreshold > 1

rules.description: Every port referenced in probe handlers (httpGet.port, tcpSocket.port, grpc.port) must be declared in spec.containerPorts
probe-config-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

Timing relationships: liveness.initialDelaySeconds must be >= (startup.periodSeconds × startup.failureThreshold) to prevent liveness from killing a slow-starting container. readiness.failureThreshold should be <= liveness.failureThreshold so traffic stops before the container is restarted

constraints.liveness.initialDelaySeconds: must be >= startup.periodSeconds × startup.failureThreshold (when startup probe is defined)
